name: GPU-based Tiled Ray Casting with Depth Peeling
aliases: GPU-based Tiled Ray Casting using Depth Peeling
Tiled Ray Casting using Depth Peeling
Tiled Ray Casting with Depth Peeling
definition: A ray-casting algorithm for time-varying scalar fields on unstructured meshes, implemented using DirectX 9.0c, which uses depth peeling to handle non-convex meshes.
summary: GPU-based Tiled Ray Casting with Depth Peeling is a hardware-accelerated volume rendering algorithm for unstructured tetrahedral meshes that uses screen tiling and depth peeling to correctly handle non-convexity without convexification.
